# A resolution is finished when a stranger can reuse it

The audit's precedent-quality score kept converging on one question: could a person who
has never seen this ticket resolve the next identical failure from the record alone? A
record passes when it states the failure signature, the accepted fix as performed, and
the verification that confirmed the fix, each in its own sentence. Close the loop at
resolution time, because a record patched up weeks later during an audit reliably loses
the verification detail.
